response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS benchmark FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.film_count, p.avg_ratio / b.benchmark AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE b.benchmark IS NOT NULL
